Molecular weight, normal boiling point, Tc, Pc and acentric factor as given; standard liquid density: eq. 105 saturated liquid at 288.7056 K (60 F), as the bundled light ends; ideal-gas Cp eq. 16 (A=38238.49, B=-511.235, C=12.39338, D=-0.000121482, E=4.39211e-8; data 80..1500 K) fitted by least squares as shifted_polynomial_5 over 164.25..900 K (31 points), largest deviation -0.426 % at 164.3 K, 0.160 % over 298.15..900 K; viscosity tables and freezing data in their entries. fluid_domain.evidence: Fluid network only (not the column range): the ideal-gas Cp fit range, from max(ChemSep Cp data start, triple point) to 900 K; below it Cp is held and integrated, with a notice (a data-range end, never a validity floor). 100 Pa..2000000 Pa as the bundled light ends: PR78 from ChemSep critical constants, not qualified above that.
